meta.title: KepToh POS | POS for Thai BBQ & Buffet Restaurants , Per-Head Billing, Works Offline

pain.title: What a busy mookata night usually looks like

items.title: Head counts on paper
items.body: How many adults, how many kids, what time they sat down. Once the room fills up, things get missed and tables run over time.

items.title: Wi-Fi drops at checkout
items.body: The online POS freezes while guests wait to pay. You write bills by hand, then type them in again after closing.

items.title: No idea what you made today
items.body: You know the sales. You don't know how much pork, veg and charcoal went out. The leak shows up at month end.

offline.title: Wi-Fi down? Keep taking payments.
offline.sub: Bills are saved on the device first and sent up when the connection comes back. Nothing to re-type. Switch the internet off below and issue a few bills.

offline.msgOffline: Internet cut. You can still issue bills.

features.title: Built for buffet restaurants
features.sub: Every screen below is a real screenshot from the demo shop.

items.title: Per-head pricing with a timer
items.body: Pick a package, enter adults, kids and toddlers. Prices and the countdown are automatic; tables over time turn red.

items.title: Every zone on one screen
items.body: See which tables are free and which are waiting for the bill, split by indoor, terrace and VIP.

items.title: Abbreviated and full tax invoices
items.body: VAT-registered shops can issue both. Pre-tax amounts are split out, and voids or replacements keep their history.

items.title: Closing stock count
items.body: Count only what's left. Usage is worked out for you, and low or out-of-stock items are flagged.

items.title: Shifts and cash drawer
items.body: Enter the float when the shift opens, count the drawer when it closes, and see the over or short.

items.title: Daily profit
items.body: Close the day and see sales, ingredient cost and profit for that day. No waiting for month end.

tax.title: Tax invoices from the checkout screen
tax.sub: Walk-in guests get an abbreviated invoice. Company guests can get a full one at the table with their tax ID and branch.
points: Tax ID, branch code and machine code printed on every invoice
VAT 7% included, with the pre-tax amount split out
Voids and replacements reference the original

items.q: Does it work for a mookata restaurant out of the box?
items.a: Yes. It is built for buffet restaurants: adult, child and toddler pricing, table timers and table zones.

items.q: Does it work offline? What happens if the internet drops?
items.a: Yes. If the connection drops you can still open tables and issue bills. Bills are stored on the device and sync automatically when the internet returns.

items.q: Can it issue abbreviated and full tax invoices?
items.a: Yes. It supports both. Full tax invoices record buyer details such as tax ID and branch. Please confirm real-world usage with your shop's accountant.

items.q: Does it work on iPad and tablets?
items.a: Yes. KepToh runs in the browser and its layout is tuned for iPad and tablets. You can pair several devices to one shop.
It's free to try during the launch period, with no credit card. If we introduce paid plans later, we'll tell you well in advance.
Each shop's data is kept separate and access requires authentication. We're preparing a PDPA-style privacy policy, which is currently a draft pending legal review.
